title: Non-Executing Advisory Delivery
description: Decouple analytical insights from market execution. Provide insights on non-executing basis.

title: Beginners Profile Guardrails
description: Restricted to broad-market equity mutual funds, liquid ETFs, top-tier large-cap. Quarterly rebalancing.

title: Retail Profile Guardrails
description: Balanced access. Strict single-stock limits (max 10%). Weekly/bi-weekly rebalancing.

title: HNI Profile Guardrails
description: Full multi-asset access. Higher position concentration. Real-time/daily rebalancing.

title: Price Momentum Logs
description: Track structural asset momentum, historical price patterns, volatility trends.

title: Dividend Structures
description: Analyze historical corporate dividend distribution growth and ex-dividend dates.

title: Shareholding Patterns
description: Evaluate quarterly exchange disclosures to monitor institutional capital movements.

title: Macro Cyclicals
description: Adjust baseline allocations according to broader economic environment.

title: Live News Feeds
description: Aggregate live financial newswires, earnings calls to calculate sentiment signals.

title: Phase 1: Indian Equities
description: Direct equities listed on NSE and BSE.

title: Friction & Tax Leakage Layer
description: Holding period verification, STCG/LTCG optimization, mutual fund exit loads, HNI surcharges.

title: Explainable AI (XAI)
description: User Rationale Panel translating deep-learning assessments into clear market drivers.
